mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.category_id, c.name AS category_name, f.name, f.description, f.price, f.original_price, f.image_url, f.stock, f.sales, f.recommended, f.special_offer, f.status, f.created_at, f.updated_at FROM food f LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = f.category_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND (f.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR f.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND f.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY f.id DESC

SELECT f.id, f.category_id, c.name AS category_name, f.name, f.description, f.price, f.original_price, f.image_url, f.stock, f.sales, f.recommended, f.special_offer, f.status, f.created_at, f.updated_at FROM food f LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = f.category_id WHERE f.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food (category_id, name, description, price, original_price, image_url, stock, recommended, special_offer, status) VALUES (#{request.categoryId}, #{request.name}, #{request.description}, #{request.price}, #{request.originalPrice}, #{request.imageUrl}, #{request.stock}, COALESCE(#{request.recommended}, 0), COALESCE(#{request.specialOffer}, 0), COALESCE(#{request.status}, 1))
mapper.update: UPDATE food SET category_id = #{request.categoryId}, name = #{request.name}, description = #{request.description}, price = #{request.price}, original_price = #{request.originalPrice}, image_url = #{request.imageUrl}, stock = #{request.stock}, recommended = COALESCE(#{request.recommended}, 0), special_offer = COALESCE(#{request.specialOffer}, 0), status = COALESCE(#{request.status}, 1) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE food SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE food SET stock = #{stock} WHERE id = #{id}
